passive.name: Garden of Thorns
passive.tooltip:
Zyra spawns Seeds around herself every @SeedCooldown@ seconds that last 30 seconds. She can have 8 Seeds planted at once. If an enemy champion steps on a Seed, it dies. Zyra will not spawn Seeds while hiding in brush.

These Seeds are used by her other Abilities to spawn plants that deal @PlantDamage@ magic damage.

spells.name: Deadly Spines
spells.tooltip:
Zyra causes thick vines to spread and explode into spines, dealing @InitialDamage@ magic damage.

If this Ability is cast near a Seed, the Seed grows into a Thorn Spitter that deals @spell.ZyraP:PlantDamage@ magic damage and lasts @spell.ZyraP:PlantDuration@ seconds. Thorn Spitters have 575 range.

spells.name: Rampant Growth
spells.tooltip:
Zyra plants a Seed that lasts @SeedDuration@ seconds. These Seeds grant True Sight of enemy champions that step on them for @VisionGranted@ seconds, but are still destroyed.

This Ability has 2 charges with a @AmmoRechargeTime@ second recharge time. Killing an enemy minion or monster reduces the recharge time by @KillAmmoRefundMinion*100@%. Champion takedowns reduce the recharge time by @KillAmmoRefundChamp*100@% instead.

spells.name: Grasping Roots
spells.tooltip:
Zyra sends vines forward, Rooting for @RootDuration@ second(s) and dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

If this Ability passes near a Seed, the Seed grows into a Vine Lasher that deals @spell.ZyraP:PlantDamage@ magic damage and lasts @spell.ZyraP:PlantDuration@ seconds. Vine Lashers have 400 range, and their Attacks Slow by @SlowAmountPlantAttack@% for @SlowDurationPlantAttack@ seconds. The Slow from multiple Vine Lashers stacks up to @MaxSlowStacks@ times.

spells.name: Stranglethorns
spells.tooltip:
Zyra summons the fury of nature, growing a twisted thicket that deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage. After 2 seconds, the vines snap upwards, Knocking Up for @KnockupDuration@ second.

Zyra's plants within the thicket become enraged, resetting their duration, gaining @EnragedBonusHealthPercent*100@% Health and Attacking for @PlantDamageBonus@% bonus damage.
